辞亲城（辞亲城（第22页）他辅佐司王数千年，只一眼便明白了其深意。这是要让万族之人伪装成寻找机缘的修士，混入无妄疆，暗中接近那个镖人和颜如玉，跟在他们身后，待找到诡源封印之地，再一举夺下。紧接着，阎摩又冲着冥婆少司下令。“接下来，你全力辅助镇狱少司，一明一暗相互配合，只许成功，不许失败！”“是！”冥婆少司躬身领命。阎摩沉吟几秒，最后看向无形少司。“你，即刻起看住归墟之地与北冥之地的通界，但凡有任何陌生强者入境，立刻回报！”无形少司愣了愣。为何要守住那通界。很快他想到了最近收到的一些消息，归墟之地各大冥族异动，北冥之地消失百年的各大诡族少主突然回归。难不成他们都知道那个颜如玉要去打开封印？他不敢再耽搁，当即抱拳领命，“是！”……渡厄司那边急不可耐，这头的陈观三人却玩得不亦乐乎。此刻，他们来到一座名为“辞亲城”的城池。此城乃是浩疆与无妄疆的交界，也是那些妄图前往无妄疆寻找机缘之人的最后一个落脚点。许多人都在此城留下遗言，以明前行之志。此城便是因此而得名。城中街道四通八达，人来人往，各种叫卖吆喝声不绝于耳。人群中，一个小丫头迈着小短腿，在这个摊位前瞅几眼，那个摊位前看几眼，可问来问去，一听到价钱就摇摇头不买了。“丫头，喜欢就买。”陈观上前，一把拿起摊位上一个小燕子样式的木雕，甩出几枚铜币后，便塞到了燕乐乐的手中。“哎呀，陈哥哥，你再买我就装不下了！”小丫头说着，拍了拍身后那个鼓囊囊的包包，发出一串叮当乱响。这小包裹中全是在路过的几座城中买来的各种小玩意，有小土狗模样的布偶，有按一下就会蹦起来的铁皮蛤蟆，更有摇起来“咚咚锵”响的拨浪鼓。这小丫头虽懂事，但毕竟只是个六七岁的孩子，贪玩本就是天性。陈观这么做，也算是在弥补她失去的童年。小丫头没有拒绝，只是甜甜地说了声：“谢谢陈哥哥！”随后，便又跑到另一个摊位，拉着嘴巴塞得满满的颜宝儿。“宝儿姐，陈哥哥又送我一个礼物！”“唔唔……你陈哥哥真大气。”颜宝儿含糊不清地点了点头。她这几日，到了一处便胡吃海喝，之前的悲伤仿佛忘得一干二净。前一秒还能伤心欲绝，后一秒就能生死离别抛到脑后。在外人看来，这丫头属实没心没肺，但陈观不这么觉得，他知道这死丫头是在担心以后再也吃不到了，想一次性吃个够本。而这种情况，通常只会出现在将死之人满足最后遗愿的时候。而这座城本就是满足前往无妄疆之人，心中最后的遗憾。“行了行了，吃够了没有？吃够了就该出发了。”“唔，差不多了。”颜宝儿点了点头，随手又拿起一个刚出炉的饼，让摊贩老板给她包上好几个，这才心满意足地跟上陈观的脚步。陈观扛着斩马刀，看着街道上形形色色的人物。就在他目光扫过街道旁一座酒楼时，眉头微微一皱。

Ciqin City (Ciqin City (page 22)) He has assisted King Si for thousands of years, and he understood its deep meaning at a glance. This is to let people of all races disguise themselves as monks looking for opportunities, sneak into Wuwujiang, and secretly approach the bodyguard and Yan. Ruyu followed them, waiting to find the place where the strange source was sealed, and then seize it in one fell swoop. Then, Yan Mo gave an order to Master Mingpo, "Next, you will do your best to assist Master Suppressing Prison, and cooperate with each other in the light and in the dark. Don't fail!" "Yes!" Ming Po Shao Si bowed to accept the order. Yan Mo pondered for a few seconds, and finally looked at Invisible Shao Si. "You, immediately watch the connection between Guixu Land and Beiming Land, if any strange and powerful people enter. , report back immediately!" The invisible young master was stunned. Why should he guard the realm? Soon he thought of some news he had received recently. The major Ming tribes in the Guixu Land had moved, and the young masters of the Wei Clan who had disappeared for hundreds of years in the North Ming Land suddenly returned. Come back. Could it be that they all knew that Yan Ruyu was going to open the seal? He didn't dare to delay any longer, and immediately accepted the order with his fists in his hands, "Yes!"... Du'esi was impatient, but Chen Guan and the other three were having a great time. At this moment, they came to a city called "Ciqin City". This city is the border between Haojiang and Wuwangjiang, and it is also the last place for those who want to go to Wuwangjiang to find opportunities. This is how the city got its name. The streets are connected in all directions, and people are coming and going. Among the crowd, there is a little girl with short legs and a few glances in front of this stall. , I looked at the stall a few times, but after asking around, I shook my head when I heard the price. "Girl, buy it if you like it." Chen Guan stepped forward, picked up a small swallow-shaped wood carving on the stall, and threw out a few copper coins. , and stuffed it into Yan Lele's hand. "Oh, Brother Chen, I won't be able to fit it in if you buy it again!" The little girl said, patting the bulging bag behind her, making a bunch of jingles. Various knick-knacks bought from the towns I passed by include stuffed animals that look like little local dogs, tin toads that jump when pressed, and rattles that make a "dong, dong, clang" sound when shaken. Although this little girl is sensible, she is still just a little girl. She is a six- or seven-year-old child who is playful by nature. Chen Guan did this to make up for her lost childhood. The little girl did not refuse, but said sweetly: "Thank you, Brother Chen!" Then she ran to another stall and pulled Yan Bao'er with her mouth full. "Sister Bao'er, Brother Chen gave me another gift!" "Uh-huh... Brother Chen is so grand." Yan Baoer nodded vaguely. As they ate and drank together, the previous sorrow seemed to be completely forgotten. One moment, she could be heartbroken, but the next moment, she could forget about life and death. To outsiders, this girl was really heartless, but Chen Guan didn't think so. He knew that this dead girl was worried that she would never be able to eat again and wanted to eat enough at once. This situation usually only occurs when the dying person fulfills his last wish. The last regret in the heart of a person who has no boundaries. "Okay, okay, have you eaten enough? It's time to leave after eating enough." Yan Baoer nodded, picked up another freshly baked cake, and asked the stall owner to wrap several for her, and then followed Chen Guan's footsteps with satisfaction. Chen Guan was holding the sword and looking at the various people on the street. As he glanced at a restaurant next to the street, he frowned slightly.
